items.title: Mai Fatty Urges Wuli Residents to Reject Opposition, Singles Out UDP
items.summary: By Makutu Manneh Mai Ahmed Fatty, leader of the Gambia Moral Congress (GMC) and coordinator of the National People’s Party (NPP) Political Alliance Secretariat, has urged residents of Wuli in the Upper River Region to reject opposition parties, particularly the United Democrat...
